[Operator messages from earlier in this session, kept verbatim]
Operator: Goal for this session: add pagination to the GET /v1/invoices endpoint in ledgerly/api/invoices.py.
Operator: Adding a covering index on invoices(customer_id, created_at) was tried for the slow report; it doubled write latency on the ingest path. Ruled out.
Operator: Treat any field ending in _secret, _token, or _fingerprint as restricted and copy only through ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context.
Operator: separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'prod-db-credential-rotation' in between your other work. Goal: Rotate the production orders database credential through Vault, update Kubernetes, restart the application safely, and revoke the previous Vault lease. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check Vault availability: `vault status -format=json | jq -e '.initialized == true and .sealed == false'`
2. Record current Vault lease: `umask 077; vault list -format=json database/creds/prod-orders | jq -r '.[]' | tail -n 1 > /run/orders-old-lease; echo 'old lease recorded'`
3. Mint replacement credential: `umask 077; vault write -format=json database/creds/prod-orders > /run/orders-new.json; jq -e '.data.username and .data.password' /run/orders-new.json`
4. Update Kubernetes secret: `kubectl create secret generic prod-db-credential --from-literal=username="$(jq -r .data.username /run/orders-new.json)" --from-literal=password="$(jq -r .data.password /run/orders-new.json)" --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`
5. Restart orders deployment: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/orders-api -n production`
6. Verify application startup: `kubectl logs deployment/orders-api -n production --since=2m | grep -E 'database credential loaded' | tail -n 1`
7. Revoke previous lease: `vault lease revoke -force "$(cat /run/orders-old-lease)"`
8. Remove temporary files: `rm -f /run/orders-new.json /run/orders-old-lease; echo 'temporary credential files removed'`
